sources.title: GitHub - ornith-ai/Ornith-1
sources.snippet: Aloha! 🌺 Ornith is a family of self-improving open-source models for agentic tasks. This repo covers both generations: 🐦 Ornith-1.5 (latest) — extends self-scaffolding into a complete end-to-end self-improvement loop: the model proposes new tasks, generates task-specific scaffolds, and produces solution rollouts for reinforcement learning. Model weights at HuggingFace, and more details ...

sources.title: MoE 397B Model | ornith-ai/Ornith-1 | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The Ornith-1.5-397B is the flagship variant of the Ornith model family, designed for large-scale agentic reasoning and complex software engineering tasks. It utilizes a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture with 397 billion total parameters, optimized for high-throughput inference via tensor parallelism and advanced quantization formats.

sources.title: Ornith-1.5-397B - Local AI Model - Tokenstead
sources.snippet: Built on continued pretraining of Qwen 3.5 / Gemma 4, then a self-improvement loop where the model proposes new tasks, generates task-specific scaffolds, and produces solution rollouts for RL (all three stages optimized jointly with GRPO). 262K context, MIT-licensed on HuggingFace at ornith-ai/Ornith-1.5-397B (FP8, GGUF, and NVFP4 quantizations).
